summary: This bill amends the Social Security Act to allow foster care maintenance payments for children placed in "cottage family homes," which are licensed, trauma-informed residences with live-in parents that aim to keep sibling groups together and provide a family-like environment.

scores.thoughts: This bill expands the types of facilities eligible for foster care maintenance payments under Title IV-E of the Social Security Act by including 'cottage family homes.' This would increase federal spending on foster care, thereby expanding a component of the social safety net.
